"F24"], "heading": "C — Rules of the Road (Utah Handbook Sec 9)", "learner_facing": true, "markdown": "## C — Rules of the Road (Utah Handbook Sec 9)

FACT_ID: F01 | anchor: A01
Flex lanes may reverse direction by time of day; check the overhead signal before entering [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: F02 | anchor: A01
Keep at least two seconds of following distance on the freeway; lengthen the gap when conditions worsen [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: F03 | anchor: A01
U-turns on the freeway are prohibited, as is driving or stopping for passengers in the emergency lane outside the solid white line [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: F04 | anchor: A01
A left-lane driver approached from behind must move safely right so faster traffic can pass; lingering can draw a citation for impeding [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: F05 | anchor: A02
Express lanes on I-15 are free for vehicles with two or more occupants, plus motorcycles, buses, and registered clean-fuel decal vehicles [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: F06 | anchor: A02
Crossing a double white line to enter or leave the express lane is prohibited; enter or exit only at dotted-line access points [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: F07 | anchor: A03
Ramp meters show alternating red and green and generally release one vehicle per green; obey only when the meter-on sign is lit [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: F08 | anchor: A03
Runaway-vehicle ramps are for emergency stops only; stopping, standing, or parking on or in the path of one is prohibited [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: F09 | anchor: A03
A U-turn from the off-ramp that re-enters the freeway at a single-point interchange is allowed only when facing a green arrow; finish once started [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: F10 | anchor: A04
At every intersection slow, scan for controls, cross traffic, walkers, riders, and sight blocks, and never assume others will yield [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: F11 | anchor: A04
Stop fully behind signs, signals, walks, or stop lines; when queued, leave room to see the rear tires of the vehicle ahead [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: F12 | anchor: A05
Broken yellow center lines permit passing when safe; solid lines and double-center lines restrict or bar passing as marked [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: F13 | anchor: A06
Stop behind the stop line or crosswalk at signs and signals and grant passage to anyone in or entering any crosswalk, marked or not [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: F14 | anchor: A06
Enter a shared center left-turn lane no more than 500 feet before the turn, after mirrors, signal, and blind-spot check [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: F15 | anchor: A06
Default limits absent signs or hazards are 20 near schools during recess or arrival and dismissal, 25 in business and residential areas, and 55 on major highways as posted [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: F16 | anchor: A07
Reduce speed at intersections, rail crossings, curves, hill crests, narrow or winding roads, work zones, and whenever sight or control is reduced [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: F17 | anchor: A07
Roundabout routine is slow on approach, yield to traffic inside and to walkers, enter when clear, then exit at the wanted street [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: F18 | anchor: A07
Steady yellow means the signal is about to turn red; flashing yellow means slow, proceed with care, and be ready to stop [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: F19 | anchor: A08
Flashing yellow arrow permits the turn only after yielding to oncoming traffic and walkers, who hold the green [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: F20 | anchor: A08
Right on red is allowed after a full stop unless posted otherwise; right or left on a red arrow requires waiting for a go indication [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: F21 | anchor: A09
Cross rail tracks promptly without stopping on them; if gates and lights operate, wait until arms rise and lights end before going [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: F22 | anchor: A10
Warning signs are generally diamond-shaped yellow with black symbols; guide signs are square or rectangular green, brown, or blue [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: F23 | anchor: A11
Work-zone signs are diamond or rectangular orange with black legends; speeding fines in work zones are doubled [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: F24 | anchor: A12
Grant the way to the vehicle already in the intersection, to oncoming traffic on a left turn, to the driver on the right at a tied four-way stop, and to road traffic when leaving a drive [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0060]

High_yield (ranked): 1) Signals signs and right-of-way 2) Freeway and express-lane discipline 3) Markings speed and work zones 4) Flex ramp and interchange forms.
Misconceptions: green always means go; tied four-way stop favors the left; crosswalk needs paint; double white may be crossed; ramp meter always active.
Mnemonics: Green-arrow go Red-X reject; Dotted entry Double-line deny; Flashing-yellow yield-first.
